allowlist.reason: Non-applicable: advisory is a ReDoS in twisted.mail.imap4.wildcardToRegexp(), reachable only by a Twisted IMAP4 server that passes an authenticated client's LIST/LSUB pattern to re.compile(). Baluffo runs no IMAP server and never imports twisted.mail; Twisted is a transitive Scrapy dependency selected only as twisted.internet.asyncioreactor.AsyncioSelectorReactor (src/scrapers/settings.py). No fixed release exists as of 2026-10-17: PyPI's latest is 26.4.0, the version pip-audit flags, so a bump cannot clear the finding. Revisit at review_by: drop this entry when a twisted release after 26.4.0 fixes the advisory.
